_note: Titles (war-and-realm §5; docs/v1-content.md §3.1). Per race and region, collectible, dynamic: they change hands by conquest (a holder that stops meeting a key-region condition loses the title to whoever meets them), grant, and later election and inheritance (hooks). Earned by a powerful faction that is Loved or Feared (when standing is listed) plus each title's conditions: cultures (the holder's culture), regions (settlements it must hold), realm_regions (at least n regions of a realm, the realm of each region's original owner), regions_total, vassals (at least n), most_powerful (the strongest faction of its people). grant_only titles are granted, never earned; grantable titles can be granted by their holder to a vassal or a family member as a loyalty reward. Powers (2-3 each) are effect keys the systems read: banner_turnout (x, hosts), vassal_ease (attitude points toward vassalage in deals), vassal_loyalty_floor, diplomatic_weight (attitude points with every faction), wall_garrison (Greywall garrisons, hook), winter_immunity (hook, seasons), toll_income (gold a turn), decrees (hook), holy_war (hook). Election (Senate vote), Holy Wars and Throne Church blessings come with religion and the Senate; those conditions are marked pending and cannot be met yet. PLACEHOLDER conditions and values.
